mainEntity.name: Why is local business presence important for AEO, especially in areas like Houston or Phoenix?

acceptedAnswer.text: A local business presence is crucial for AEO because many search queries, particularly those from mobile devices and voice search, have a local intent. Users often look for services or products 'near me' or within a specific city like Houston or Phoenix. Optimizing for AEO helps local businesses appear in 'local pack' results, map results, and directly answer geographically-specific questions. By creating content that directly addresses local needs and includes location-specific keywords, businesses can capture high-intent local traffic, connecting with customers actively searching for services in their immediate vicinity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Local presence is vital for AEO as many searches have local intent. Optimizing for AEO helps businesses appear in local search results and answer location-specific questions, capturing local traffic.
